audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gave Viktor 6 of 7 stages while Aurelion Sol wins 52.88% over 1477 games, and the two layers disagreed at rows 4, 5 and 6 (full said Skill/Skill/Skill, content said Viktor/Viktor/Aurelion Sol).
audit.why: Viktor genuinely owns levels 1-5: Gravity Field (W) is a stun zone on a 17s rank-1 cooldown that cancels both of Aurelion Sol's channels (Breath of Light Q and Astral Flight W), and Hextech Ray (E) clears from 525 range. From level 6 the matchup evens because Falling Star is hard CC that interrupts Viktor's Arcane Storm channel, and from two items Aurelion Sol's permanent Stardust curve passes Viktor's finite Hex Core augments.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-3 Viktor, rows 4-5 Skill, row 6 Aurelion Sol, with both layers proposed as one atomic group and the whys rewritten to match each verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every spike entry used fabricated ability names: 'Chaos Storm' for Viktor's R, 'Death Ray' for his E, and 'Comet of Legend' for an Aurelion Sol ability that no longer exists.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon gives Viktor P Glorious Evolution, Q Siphon Power, W Gravity Field, E Hextech Ray, R Arcane Storm; Aurelion Sol's R is Falling Star, upgrading to The Skies Descend once enough Stardust is banked.
audit.corrected: Spikes rewritten around Gravity Field's channel-cancel, Arcane Storm's 80-120s channel, the Hextech Ray/Siphon Power poke pattern, and the Falling Star -> The Skies Descend transformation.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interactions were never stated: Gravity Field cancels Aurelion Sol's channels, Falling Star cancels Arcane Storm, and Siphon Power's shield eats his burst.
audit.why: Aurelion Sol's Q and W both carry the interruptible-channel flag, Viktor's W carries hardCC, Viktor's R carries channel, Aurelion Sol's R carries hardCC, and Viktor's Q carries shield plus autoReset.
audit.corrected: Stated in enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns, dontsFull[1].d, dontsFull[0].d, spikes[1].text and content mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all — the exact defect the catalogue lists.
audit.why: Real numbers exist in the kits: Gravity Field 17/16/15/14/13, Astral Flight 22/20.5/19/17.5/16, Arcane Storm 120/100/80, Breath of Light 3s.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with rank-1 and rank-5 Gravity Field, Astral Flight's 22s, and Arcane Storm's 80-120s channel.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood/tradeBad/cooldown strings pasted under unrelated titles, and dontsFull[0].d was a pure template ending in the wrong pronoun ('they').
audit.why: Copy-paste bleed defect 2 and template defect from the sweep.
audit.corrected: All four bodies rewritten to answer their own titles, grounded in Viktor's kit.

audit.why: Viktor's Hex Fragments come from kills per Riot's passive text, which is why denying him the first kill delays a whole augment — used in breakdown.feeding and ahead.

edits.before: - Viktor Gravity Field: matchup-defining — The stun zone owns every all-in — walk out the moment it drops or fight outside it. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Astral Flight like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Gravity Field is 17s at rank 1 down to 13s at rank 5 — the moment it lands you cannot channel, so walk out or fight outside it. - Astral Flight is 22s at rank 1: it is your only escape, never a poke tool. - Arcane Storm is an 80-120s channel your R cancels.

edits.before: Carry by scaling honestly — every stardust stack is permanent, and the 30-minute version of you wins fights your laning self cannot imagine.
edits.after: Carry by outlasting his Hex Core: Viktor's augments finish, your Stardust does not, so every safe Q tick you took in lane is still paying at 30 minutes.

edits.before: If Viktor opens the score, reset expectations and respect Gravity Field doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with E executes and stay relevant through the stardust curve.
edits.after: If Viktor gets the first kill his Hex Core jumps a full augment, so stop contesting the wave in his half: farm the back line with E from 750 range and let his 17s Gravity Field expire on nothing.

edits.before: Ahead, compound it: shove with E executes, burn Viktor on every W rotation, and group early — your beam turns small mid-game leads into unanswerable objective control.
edits.after: Ahead, deny the Hex Core: Viktor needs kills for Hex Fragments, so shove with E executes, take his farm off him on W flybys, and choke the augments he is waiting on.

edits.before: The stun zone owns every all-in — walk out the moment it drops or fight outside it. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Every second the breath sits on Viktor banks permanent Stardust — from 750 range, at 3s cooldown, that is free scaling he cannot take back.

edits.before: W-flyby: fly a lateral arc, drag Q across Viktor for two seconds of burn + stacks, and land outside his answer range — repeat forever from one item.
edits.after: The black hole pulls the back line into its execute threshold, so the wave dies at 750 range while Viktor holds Gravity Field for a step you never take.

edits.before: That’s Viktor’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Before Rod of Ages his Siphon Power shield eats whatever burst you commit.

edits.before: Your flight is your only escape — a W spent poking is a death sentence against the next gank.
edits.after: Gravity Field cancels the Breath of Light channel — never start it while his 17s W is up.

edits.before: Channelling Q face-to-face inside his engage range with W down — every champion that touches you wins that exchange pre-items.
edits.after: Astral Flight is 22s at rank 1 and it is your only way out — landing next to a Viktor holding W ends the game for you.
